summary: Frontend-only retest of the Interactive City Map after switch to GTA V tiles (gta5-map.github.io) with Leaflet CRS.Simple. All 6 required checks pass: tiles load in-browser (naturalWidth=256, complete=true, src contains gta5-map.github.io), 6 blips render with 'All' filter, filter buttons yield correct counts (police=2, safe=2, business=2, all=6), style toggle switches tile URL to /satellite/ and /road/ with tiles still loading (9/9 each), popup opens on blip click showing category label + name + description, and NO console errors/warnings (leaflet or otherwise) captured during the entire flow.

issues: At default zoom=3 / center=[-44,44] the tile pyramid only fills the right ~55% of the map wrapper on 1920px viewports (left ~500px is dark). Tiles themselves are fine and loaded; consider bumping default zoom to 4 or shifting center so the GTA V atlas fills the container edge-to-edge for a stronger first impression. Cosmetic, not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: ServerMap.jsx correctly uses key={mapStyle} on TileLayer to force reload on style change — good.
maxBounds [[8,-8],[-96,96]] extends slightly beyond the tile bounds [[0,0],[-88,88]] which is fine (viscosity 0.9 keeps it snappy), no issues observed.
noWrap=true on TileLayer prevents tile repetition — correct for CRS.Simple.
Consider setting a fallback / errorTileUrl on TileLayer for graceful degradation if gta5-map.github.io ever goes down (currently would show broken tiles).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Map module fully verified end-to-end via Playwright on the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Tile pyramid pattern {z}-{x}_{y}.png works. Only cosmetic framing suggestion noted. No further map testing needed unless the tile source or CRS is changed.
